upgrades.name: Permanent Slice Value
upgrades.description: Good seeds remember a productive kitchen. Every future cut benefits, including this cycle.
upgrades.effect: +25% permanent cut value per level

upgrades.name: Starting Cash
upgrades.description: A small envelope for the next beginning. Granted after your next prestige, never counted as harvest earnings.
upgrades.effect: +$5 starting cash per level on future prestige resets

upgrades.name: Golden Harvest
upgrades.description: A dedicated invitation to the rare golden specimen. Ordinary cultivation cannot open this envelope.
upgrades.effect: Unlocks automatic Golden Tomato events

upgrades.name: Golden Frequency
upgrades.description: A little more room in the calendar for extraordinary produce. Cooldowns and capacity still apply.
upgrades.effect: +4 percentage points per event check per level

upgrades.name: Golden Value
upgrades.description: The rare specimen now arrives with a more persuasive invoice. The original family still shares one cut budget.
upgrades.effect: +50% Golden Tomato value per level

upgrades.name: Stampede Season
upgrades.description: A special permit for a rather unreasonable quantity of small tomatoes. Golden invitations are a separate matter.
upgrades.effect: Unlocks automatic waves of smaller eligible tomatoes

upgrades.name: Stampede Frequency
upgrades.description: A fuller calendar of group arrivals. Each wave still needs room for the entire party.
upgrades.effect: +5 percentage points per stampede check per level

upgrades.name: Larger Stampedes
upgrades.description: Two more places at the cutting board. Shared capacity and the original family cut budgets still apply.
upgrades.effect: +2 tomatoes per stampede per level

upgrades.name: Stampede Rewards
upgrades.description: Small specimens, increasingly distinguished invoices. Ordinary price and combo bonuses still apply once.
upgrades.effect: +50% base stampede cut value per level

upgrades.name: Giant Harvest
upgrades.description: A dedicated permit for one unusually substantial visitor. Ordinary Beefsteaks are a separate matter.
upgrades.effect: Unlocks automatic durable giant tomato events

upgrades.name: Giant Frequency
upgrades.description: A more generous appointment book for very large produce. Full-field and active-family limits still apply.
upgrades.effect: +4 percentage points per giant check per level

upgrades.name: Giant Rewards
upgrades.description: Substantial produce now receives a substantial invoice. Damage alone still earns nothing.
upgrades.effect: +50% base giant cut value per level

upgrades.name: Giant Bonus Cuts
upgrades.description: One more useful division of the enormous original. Every descendant still shares its family ledger.
upgrades.effect: +1 rewarded giant cut per level; shared maximum 7

upgrades.name: Heirloom Celebration
upgrades.description: A rare-seed invitation for Amber Lantern, Sage Pinstripe and Violet Pear. This collection never grants ordinary variety unlocks.
upgrades.effect: Unlocks automatic colorful premium Rainbow Harvest waves

upgrades.name: Rainbow Frequency
upgrades.description: More dates for the archive collection. Every fan still needs space for all its specimens.
upgrades.effect: +4 percentage points per rainbow check per level

upgrades.name: Rainbow Rewards
upgrades.description: Each colorful heirloom carries a more distinguished invoice, based on your best eligible normal quality.
upgrades.effect: +50% base rainbow cut value per level

upgrades.name: Extended Harvest
upgrades.description: One more place in every colorful fan. The complete wave must fit and each family keeps its own cut budget.
upgrades.effect: +1 tomato per Rainbow Harvest per level

upgrades.name: Jackpot Harvest
upgrades.description: A sealed invitation for one exceptionally rare archive specimen. Golden Beauty and the other event invitations are separate matters.
upgrades.effect: Unlocks automatic exceptionally rare Tomato Jackpots

upgrades.name: Jackpot Frequency
upgrades.description: A few more appointments for the rarest visitor. It still appears at most once per round.
upgrades.effect: +1.5 percentage points per jackpot check per level

upgrades.name: Jackpot Multiplier
upgrades.description: The specimen carries a considerably more persuasive invoice. Damage alone still earns nothing.
upgrades.effect: +50% base jackpot cut value per level

upgrades.name: Jackpot Duration
upgrades.description: A slower passage through the same arc gives the whole specimen more time at the board. The round timer and fragment lives stay unchanged.
upgrades.effect: +15% whole-specimen airtime per level at the same arc height

upgrades.name: Starting Round Time
upgrades.description: A little more time in every future round, including this cycle. Ordinary Extra Seconds remain a separate cultivation branch.
upgrades.effect: +4 seconds to round starts per level; shared 60-second ceiling

upgrades.name: Overtime Bonus
upgrades.description: A productive kitchen earns a longer extension. Requires ordinary Overtime to be cultivated; its normal prerequisites and four-trigger limit still apply.
upgrades.effect: +20% of cultivated Overtime per level; shared 60-second ceiling
